title: Creamy Cod-Free Australian Soup
description: A vegetarian take on a classic Australian-inspired soup, using velvety potatoes for a rich and creamy texture.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and diced celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced sweet potatoes, flour, and vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to the stovetop and add the milk, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer the soup over low heat until heated through.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with chopped parsley.
